answer: Require each identity to lock a refundable bond that only vests after peers countersign useful work across several epochs. Like water carving karst, honest history accumulates slowly and cannot be faked quickly; a falcon-fast newcomer still waits. Splitting into many accounts multiplies the locked capital and waiting time, and a lagoon of linked fakes found cheating loses every bond at once, so sybils cost real funds while honest agents recover theirs.
